raw_response: DESCRIPTION: The pie chart, titled "儿童长新闻数量" (Children's Long News Volume), displays the distribution of long-form news articles across eight different categories. The chart is composed of eight distinct colored slices, each representing a category and its corresponding percentage of the total. The categories and their approximate percentages are: 体育 (Sports) at 4% (blue), 社会 (Society) at 20% (orange), 榜样 (Role Models) at 19% (yellow), 政治 (Politics) at 6% (green), 文化 (Culture) at 14% (teal), 经济 (Economy) at 2% (red), 科学 (Science) at 21% (dark blue), and 环境保护 (Environmental Protection) at 14% (brown). The percentages are clearly labeled within each slice. A legend at the bottom of the chart matches the color of each slice to its corresponding category. The slices are arranged in a clockwise direction, with the largest slice (Science, 21%) positioned at the top right and the smallest (Economy, 2%) at the bottom left.
